scope: Invented arithmetic examples only; zero observed market opportunities

examples.explanation: Both fills and the shared exit are stipulated. Waiting costs two points of entry price.
The passive position is stipulated to stop at an adverse opening gap below96. No confirmation occurs.
Both entries fill, then the same fixed stop is reached. Waiting loses more here.
The passive order is stipulated not to fill at its touch; a later confirmation does fill. No queue probability is inferred.
